text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai FS, the first GⅠ 
race. The Trainer is stiff with tension in 
the air. Invited by Fuji Kiseki, they take 
a deep breath together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki casually takes the lead with 
her Trainer to ease their nerves. 
Promising to put on a great show, she 
heads off to the race.
